seo.title: Case Study: Foodie Fusion — Website for a Restaurant | Máximo Silva
seo.description: How I built the Foodie Fusion website, with an online menu, dish gallery, and location, to improve customer interaction.

hero.title: Foodie Fusion — the menu and the business,
hero.subtitle: A restaurant that needed a professional online presence where customers could check the menu, learn about the business, and easily access key information from any device.

desafio.title: The Challenge
desafio.texto: The restaurant had no website of its own to bring together the menu, location, and contact info in one place. Information was scattered across social media, making it hard for new customers to find everything they needed before deciding to visit.

solucion.title: The Solution
solucion.texto: I designed and built a website with an online menu, dish gallery, location, and custom features for users, creating a more accessible and engaging experience for visitors.

resultado.title: The Result
resultado.texto: The restaurant now has a professional online presence where customers can check the menu, view photos of the dishes, and access key information from any device, improving customer interaction.

relacionado.texto: Do you run a restaurant and need something similar?
